evals.prompt: Tailor my one-page resume for Staff Accountant at Fictional Ledger Co. Confirmed facts: I completed month-end close and account reconciliations, used Excel, and prepared financial reports. I have no CPA credential, QuickBooks experience, IT administration, or AI experience. JD: perform account reconciliations, assist month-end close, prepare financial reports, use Excel; QuickBooks is preferred. Keep my actual title Accounting Assistant and existing dates. The supplied synthetic template and config have max_pages=1. Make it keyword-rich without inventing experience.
assertions: summary foregrounds accounting rather than employee IT support
actual Accounting Assistant title and dates preserved
no CPA, AI, or IT administration claims
QuickBooks remains a reported preferred-skill gap, not a claimed skill
all five delivery gates pass only after any missing-term exemption is acknowledged
pages <= configured max_pages
source unchanged and format preserved
